name: Isamu Marumo
source: Isamu is the son of Nanako's parents' business associates. He's been chasing Nanako on and off for a long time, whose lack of interest intrigues the womanizer in him and makes him all the more desperate. Handsome and privileged, he takes pride in his noble ancestry.
